items.title: About the resort
items.description: A tropical forest retreat near Ao Nang Beach, with villas set among lush greenery and mountain views. Source: official website home page, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Rooms & amenities
items.description: Deluxe Cottages, Jacuzzi Villas, Tree Top Villas and Premium Jacuzzi Villas are listed on the resort website. Rooms include free Wi-Fi. Source: Accommodation, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Restaurants & dining
items.description: De’fish Seafood Restaurant serves seafood, Thai and European food, including halal options. The site also lists Fiore Coffee and a Pool Bar. Confirm current hours with reception. Source: Dining, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Spa, pool & activities
items.description: The resort website lists a pool with a view, massage, and an on-site zipline adventure. Confirm availability and current hours with reception. Source: Facilities and Activities, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Special offers
items.description: For current offers and booking terms, ask reception or visit the official resort website. Offers change and are not stored in this offline guide. Source: Offers, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Explore Krabi
items.description: The resort website highlights Ao Nang Beach, Poda Island and zipline activities. Ask the tour desk for current transport and excursion details. Source: Facilities and Activities, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Guest services
items.description: The resort lists a 24-hour front desk, concierge, room service, laundry, luggage storage and a tour desk. Source: Facilities, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Wi-Fi
items.description: Complimentary Wi-Fi is listed for guest rooms. Ask reception for the current network and password. Source: Facilities and FAQ, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Reception
items.description: 24-hour front desk. Tel: +66 75 695522-3. Email: info@aonangfiore.com. Source: Facilities and Contact, checked 2026-10-30.

items.title: Check-in and check-out
items.description: The FAQ lists check-in from 2:00 PM and check-out until 11:00 AM. Confirm exceptions with reception. Source: FAQ, checked 2026-10-30.
